title: 1989 Topps Baseball #5 Record Breaker Orel Hershiser 59 Scoreless Innings
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1989 Topps Baseball card features the legendary Orel Hershiser, a Major League Baseball player for the Los Angeles Dodgers. The card is part of the Base Set and has the card number #59. It was manufactured by Topps in 1989 and is a must-have for any baseball card collector.

The card is standard-sized and has not been autographed. It showcases Hershiser as a record-breaker, having pitched 59 scoreless innings. This Sports Trading Card is a great addition to any collection and a true gem for fans of the sport.
